entries.title: Job 14:1
segments: Man born of woman [is] of few days, and full of trouble.

entries.title: Job 14:2
segments: He comes forth like a flower, and withers; he also flees as a shadow, and does not stand.

entries.title: Job 14:3
segments: And You open Your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with You.

entries.title: Job 14:4
segments: Who can bring a clean [thing] out of an unclean? No one!

entries.title: Job 14:5
segments: For his days [are] fixed, the number of his months [is] with You, and You have set his bounds so that he cannot pass;

entries.title: Job 14:6
segments: look away from him, so that he may rest until he shall finish his day, as a hireling.

entries.title: Job 14:7
segments: For there is hope of a tree, if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, and its tender branch will not cease.

entries.title: Job 14:8
segments: Though its root becomes old in the earth, and its stump dies in the dust,

entries.title: Job 14:9
segments: [yet] at the scent of water it will bud and bring forth branches like a plant.

entries.title: Job 14:10
segments: But man dies and is cut off; and man expires, and where [is] he?

entries.title: Job 14:11
segments: [As] the waters fail from the sea, and a river falls away and dries up,

entries.title: Job 14:12
segments: so man lies down and does not rise. Till the heavens [are] no more, they shall not awake, nor be awakened out of their sleep.

entries.title: Job 14:13
segments: Who will grant [that] You would hide me in the grave, that You would keep me secret, until Your wrath is past, that You would set me a fixed time and remember me?

entries.title: Job 14:14
segments: If a man die, shall he revive? All the days of my warfare I will wait, until my change comes.

entries.title: Job 14:15
segments: You shall call, and I will answer You; You shall have a desire to the work of Your hands.

entries.title: Job 14:16
segments: For now You number my steps; do You not watch over my sin?

entries.title: Job 14:17
segments: My transgression [is] sealed up in a bag, and You cover over my iniquity.

entries.title: Job 14:18
segments: And surely a falling mountain crumbles away, and the rock moves out of its place.

entries.title: Job 14:19
segments: The waters wear away the stones; the outpouring of it washes the dust of the earth; and You cause the hope of man to perish.

entries.title: Job 14:20
segments: You overpower him forever, and he passes; You change his face, and send him away.

entries.title: Job 14:21
segments: His sons come to honor, and he knows it not; they fall, but he does not mark [it].

entries.title: Job 14:22
segments: But his flesh is pained within him; and his soul mourns over him.
